svg.title: Sessions vs Tokens
svg.desc: Sessions vs Tokens. Server-side sessions versus self-contained tokens: where the state lives and how you revoke it. Step 1, Sign-in: Sign-in: a session keeps state in a store and hands out a random ID; a token carries signed claims. Step 2, Every request: Every request: the session ID is looked up in the store; the token is verified locally, no lookup. Step 3, Scale out: Scale out: every app server must reach the same store; any API server verifies the token by itself. Step 4, Revoke: Revoke: delete the session row and the next request is refused; the token stays valid until exp.

g.text: Sign-in: a session keeps state in a store and hands out a random ID; a token carries signed claims.
Every request: the session ID is looked up in the store; the token is verified locally, no lookup.
Scale out: every app server must reach the same store; any API server verifies the token by itself.
Revoke: delete the session row and the next request is refused; the token stays valid until exp.

Any server, or any other service
